'''Kin Tovere''' is a lensmaker from [[Cairhien]]. 

== Appearance ==
He is stocky and bald.

== Activities ==
He invented a telescope which [[Rand al'Thor]] uses to watch the battle of [[Cairhien]] through and currently works at Rand's [[School of Cairhien]].

He later draws up plans for a telescope which can look to the stars. Rand is so impressed he tells Kin to start building it.

[[Idrien Tarsin]] reports to Rand that Kin has finished his looking glass and can now see the moon quite clearly.
